selection: TPE ranks mean trained validation accuracy across all five fixed folds; test is excluded
test_policy: one final selected-serving test per declared child; never select using test
aggregation_policy: single ten-choice window, one forward, no tournament or null choices

balance.method: retain every unique case; classes already balanced

purpose: 20 LR-only TPE trials evaluated on the same five class-stratified scenario-preserving folds; all non-LR optimizer settings fixed from prior joint-search validation winner

tracking_notes.searched_parameters: Only LR varies. WD/smoothing are singleton spaces to reuse existing Hyperopt API; all other settings fixed.
tracking_notes.validation_display: Root child trial val metrics are five-fold selected-head mean and sample std; cv_search_accuracy is mean best-trained validation accuracy used by TPE. Fold child val metrics retain last-epoch semantics; selected head metrics in details/report.json.
tracking_notes.comparison: Grouped stratified CV on original train600. Each fold trains480/validates120,12 per tool in validation. Original val20 not used. Original test20 preserved per-fold, never passed into TPE; test metrics at trial level average five fold-trained models, not a full600 model or independent final estimate.

reference_runs.selected_by: highest completed joint-search best-trained validation accuracy; tie-break lower LR

cv.stratify: actual tool ID, not permuted alias
